subtitles.text: Insert the handle into the floor washer until it clicks into place.
Fill the Clean Water Tank with clean tap water.
Add Tineco Cleaning Solution as directed.
Insert the brush roller into the holder and secure it in place.
Step on the floorhead and pull the handle backward.
Press the power button to start cleaning.
Start cleaning everyday wet and dry messes.
Press the mode button to switch cleaning modes.
Slides under low furniture to clean hidden dust.
Cleans close along walls and baseboards.
Place the appliance on the charging dock after use.
Press the self-cleaning button to start the cleaning cycle.
Cleans the brush roller and internal pathway automatically.
Rinse the dry filter with clean water.
Open the Dirty Water Tank lid.
Empty the dirty water and remove debris.
Use the cleaning tool to remove remaining debris.
Rinse the Dirty Water Tank thoroughly.
Allow all parts to air-dry completely before reassembly.
Reinstall the tank lid and dry filter.
Welcome to the tutorial video for FLOOR ONE STRETCH S6.
We will guide you through the unboxing and
initial setup process of FLOOR ONE STRETCH S6.
Insert it into the appliance until you hear a click
Put the machine on the dock to charge
Pour in the cleaning solution of Tineco
*DO NOT USE ANY OTHER CLEANING SOLUTION
*THE CLEAN WATER TANK IS ABOVE THE BRUSH HEAD
Press the power button and the appliance will
start in AUTO Mode by default.
Dock your FLOOR ONE STRETCH S6
The Brush Roller is totally dried
Use the cleaning tool to remove remaining debris
